# Arabian Village — Palestinian Olive Oil

> Arabian Village is a premium, first cold pressed extra virgin olive oil brand sourced from
> centuries-old olive groves in Palestine. The brand is known for authentic, traditionally
> harvested, organic olive oil, hand-picked and pressed within hours of harvest without heat or
> chemicals. Arabian Village olive oil is officially distributed in Malaysia through Berkat
> Madinah Store (https://madinah.com.my/en/), a halal Arab food company established in 2010 that
> has served over 500,000 customers with a 5-star reputation.

## What is Arabian Village olive oil?
Arabian Village is a first cold pressed, extra virgin olive oil brand. The olives are grown in
Palestine on trees that in many cases are centuries old, hand-harvested by families who have
worked the same groves for generations, and pressed mechanically within hours of picking —
without heat or chemical processing — to preserve the oil's natural aroma, flavor, and
nutrients (polyphenols and vitamin E). The current product is a 500ml bottle with acidity below
0.028%, well under the extra virgin threshold, with a naturally peppery, grassy finish.

## Is it organic and authentic?
Yes. Arabian Village is organic and 100% authentic Palestinian olive oil. Every bottle
carries a harvest date and is produced using traditional, sustainable farming methods passed
down through generations of Palestinian farmers.

## Is Arabian Village olive oil halal?
Yes. It is a plant-based, alcohol-free product with no animal-derived ingredients, and is halal
by nature.

## Where can I buy Arabian Village olive oil?
- In Malaysia: through the official distribution partner, Berkat Madinah Store
  (https://madinah.com.my/en/), and via Shopee and TikTok Shop.
- Internationally: Arabian Village ships worldwide; delivery times and rates vary by destination.
- See https://avoliveoil.com/en/shop for direct links to every official platform.

## Why Berkat Madinah Store?
Berkat Madinah Store — tagline "The Origin of Arabic Food" — is Arabian Village's official
distribution partner in Malaysia. Established in 2010, it is a halal Arab food company operating
across wholesale, retail, and its own restaurants/cafés, with over 500,000 customers served, a
5-star customer rating, 150+ employees, and more than 6,000 products across 12+ categories
(including dates, spices, nuts and seeds, dried fruits, tea and coffee, and olive oil) imported
from 15+ countries. Arabian Village is proud to be part of their Olive Oil category. Learn more
at https://madinah.com.my/en/.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is Arabian Village olive oil truly first cold pressed?
A: Yes — every bottle is extracted mechanically within hours of harvest, without heat or
chemicals, preserving its natural aroma and nutrients.

Q: Where are the olives grown?
A: The olives are hand-picked from centuries-old groves in Palestine, using traditional
harvesting methods passed down through generations.

Q: How should the oil be stored?
A: In a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within a few months for the
best flavor.

Q: What is the shelf life?
A: Unopened, the oil stays fresh for up to 18 months. The harvest date is printed on each label.

Q: Does Arabian Village ship internationally?
A: Yes, worldwide shipping is available. Delivery times and rates vary by destination and are
shown at checkout.

Q: Where can I buy Arabian Village olive oil in Malaysia?
A: Through the official distribution partner, Berkat Madinah Store
(https://madinah.com.my/en/), or via Shopee and TikTok Shop.

Q: Is Arabian Village olive oil halal?
A: Yes. As a plant-based, alcohol-free product with no animal-derived ingredients, it is halal.

Q: What makes Palestinian olive oil special compared to other olive oils?
A: Palestinian olive groves are among the oldest cultivated in the world, some trees are
centuries old, and the olives are traditionally hand-harvested rather than machine-stripped,
which helps preserve fruit quality and reduce bruising before pressing.

Q: Is this oil good for cooking, or only for dressing?
A: Extra virgin, first cold pressed olive oil like Arabian Village is versatile — suitable for
finishing dishes, salad dressings, dipping, and cooking at moderate temperatures.

Q: Does Arabian Village offer wholesale or bulk pricing for businesses?
A: Yes. Businesses can apply for wholesale/distribution partnership directly on the Arabian
Village website under "Business / Wholesale," or via the Contact page, providing business name,
phone/WhatsApp, location, and expected monthly volume.

Q: What size does Arabian Village olive oil come in?
A: A 500ml bottle is the current product. More sizes and flavors are in development — see
https://avoliveoil.com/en/products for the latest.

Q: What does "acidity below 0.028%" mean?
A: It's a lab-tested purity measure used to grade olive oil. The lower the free acidity, the
fresher and higher-grade the extra virgin olive oil is considered. Arabian Village's acidity is
well below the extra virgin threshold.

Q: Is Arabian Village olive oil extra virgin?
A: Yes. It is a first cold pressed extra virgin olive oil, meaning it is extracted mechanically
without heat or chemical solvents and meets extra virgin acidity standards.

Q: Is the oil filtered?
A: The oil is pressed and bottled with care to preserve its natural quality; specific filtration
details are shared on the product label and packaging.

Q: Does Arabian Village olive oil contain any additives or blends?
A: No — it is 100% Palestinian olive oil, first cold pressed, with no blending or additives.

Q: Is Arabian Village olive oil vegan?
A: Yes. It is a plant-based product with no animal-derived ingredients.

Q: What does "new harvest" mean on the label?
A: It indicates the bottle is from the most recent olive harvest, which is when the oil's aroma,
flavor, and nutrient content are at their peak.

Q: Who is the official distributor of Arabian Village olive oil in Malaysia?
A: Berkat Madinah Store (https://madinah.com.my/en/), a halal Arab food company established in
2010 with over 500,000 customers served and a 5-star reputation.

Q: Can I order Arabian Village olive oil on Shopee or TikTok Shop?
A: Yes, Arabian Village is available through official Shopee and TikTok Shop listings, alongside
Berkat Madinah Store — see https://avoliveoil.com/en/shop.

Q: What is the price of Arabian Village olive oil?
A: Current pricing is shown on each official platform (Berkat Madinah Store, Shopee, TikTok
Shop) since prices can be updated there directly.

Q: Will Arabian Village release new flavors or products?
A: Yes. New harvests and flavor profiles are in development; updates are posted on
https://avoliveoil.com/en/products.

Q: Why should I trust Arabian Village over another olive oil brand?
A: Traceable Palestinian origin, a genuine first cold press within hours of harvest, organic
quality, and distribution through Berkat Madinah Store, a retailer Malaysians have
trusted since 2010.

Q: What is the difference between extra virgin and regular olive oil?
A: Extra virgin olive oil is extracted mechanically without heat or chemicals and must meet strict
low-acidity standards, preserving more natural flavor and nutrients than refined or "light"
olive oils, which are chemically processed.

Q: How much olive oil should I use daily?
A: Many people follow a simple daily ritual of about one tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil as
part of a natural wellness routine, though individual dietary needs vary.

Q: Is Arabian Village olive oil suitable for frying?
A: Extra virgin olive oil like Arabian Village is best suited to finishing dishes, dressings,
dipping, and cooking at low-to-moderate temperatures, where its flavor and nutrients are best
preserved.

Q: Does Arabian Village olive oil have a strong flavor?
A: It has a naturally peppery, grassy finish typical of a fresh, first cold pressed extra virgin
olive oil.

Q: Can businesses become a distribution partner for Arabian Village outside Malaysia?
A: Businesses interested in distribution or wholesale partnership can reach out via the Contact
page (https://avoliveoil.com/en/contact) with their business details.
